verdict.rationale: JumpCloud documents RESTful APIs and a PowerShell module for bulk operations across users, devices, and groups (jumpcloud-docs-3, jumpcloud-docs-4). It publishes a versioned API 2.0 spec at docs.jumpcloud.com/api/2.0/index.yaml describing graph-traversal GET endpoints (jumpcloud-docs-25), and keeps an official GitHub repo of API examples (jumpcloud-gh-1). Standard OpenAPI and llms.txt discovery paths return 404 (jumpcloud-probe-1, jumpcloud-probe-3), but the spec exists at its versioned location, so this is a discoverability gap rather than a contradiction. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API, a spec at standard OpenAPI discovery paths, and detailed evidence of authentication and endpoint coverage.
